parties: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited - acquirer and target not specified in disclosure
headline: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) takeover disclosure
sum: ACJK Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or crossing of a regulatory shareholding threshold. The specific acquirer, share count, and consideration remain undisclosed in the public notification.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings are triggered when an acquirer approaches or crosses 25% shareholding or intends a public offer; counsel should immediately obtain the full disclosure document from the company registry or SEBI website to identify parties, percentage stake, consideration, and timeline.
detail: Under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, a company must file disclosure of substantial acquisition to the stock exchange. The filing is procedural confirmation that ACJK Limited has complied with the mandated disclosure regime. The notification does not detail the acquirer's identity, stake percentage, deal value, or closing timeline - these are contained in the full disclosure document (Form A or Form C) filed with NSE and held in the company's regulatory record.
